text: Charred behemoths are giant, powerful Mawsworn. These brutish iron-clad creatures use their brawn to pulverize everything that stands in their way.

C'Thraxxi (singular C'Thrax) are monstrous warbringers far larger and more resilient than other lesser n'raqi. They seem to usually serve as protectors within places of great importance to the Old Gods, and as commanders and generals of the Old Gods' forces. The C'Thrax Warlord Zon'ozz was one of the two faceless generals that led the assault on Wyrmrest Temple during the final battle against Deathwing. C'Thraxxi possess -like features, along with great strength and brutal intellect. Their dark powers can drive even titan-forged to madness. Even after what mortals might consider death, C'Thraxxi can still slowly regain their energy and return to life through external help. The Twilight's Ham

Liao-chuh Kung, also called the Wandering Dark by learned scholars, was a servant of the first Yama King to find the secret of consuming the Tainted Chi. A then revealed this secret to the other Yama Kings in exchange for vast power in the Middle Kingdom. During the following ages he had to evade the vengeful plots of his former master and grew bitter and vengeful. Seeing how all of the Yama Kings overstepped their bounds and knowing what was their original duty he then proceeded to use his granted powers to undermine the plots and plans of the Yama Kings.

Chinese Alligator Suchids are thoughtful creatures, given their near extinction. Hei Lungren is an exception to this; hatching in a nest along the Yangtze basin, she began fighting for her life almost immediately. Her First Change occurred in World War II, where she guided kinfolk peasants of a nearby village besieged by Warlords into a the safety swamp, in her Crested Dragon form. She fought against vampires that wished to drain the chi of a Dragon Nest, leaving her to this day with a hatred for the Leeches. She entered the Sleep of the Dragon after Mao's Death, though the recent menace to the Yangtze's natural energies have forced her kin to consider waking her.

:Jetpower Optimus Prime is an Autobot from the Revenge of the Fallen portion of live-action film continuity. He is also known as Power Up Optimus Prime. Jetpower Optimus Prime is the upgrade form of Optimus Prime with Jetfire's parts. In this form, Optimus possess various weapons, including a cannon on his arm, a machine gun, at least one of his swords from his normal mode and both afterburners on his back which can fire massive energy blasts as well.

The Vombis or Vombi are fictional beings created by Robert A. W. Lowndes. In his tongue-in-cheek article "Some Notes on the Vombis", the "Vombis" is presented as a singular being. Conversely, in his short story "Passage to Sharanee", they are a species or race. The Vombis are beings which can perfectly assume the form of any creature or object they desire. They antedate the universe itself, and despite having existed for countless billions of years, their culture is still in its early maturity. (: "Passage to Sharanee") Forbidden tomes such as the Song of Yste, the Necronomicon and the Unaussprechlichen Kulten make mention of the Vombis. (: "Some Notes on the Vombis")

A technique which enhances the targets gravity at the user's discretion. The enemy's mobility is diminished, as the person is crushed by gravity — and in some cases exhibit petrification-like symptoms and then began to crumble. Using a desert region to their advantage, the user can easily bury the enemy alive by submerging them in sand. When this technique is applied to the user it decreases their speed, but the increased weight drastically improves their strength. This method makes it possible for even a weak person to land a devastating hit.

The user creates water in their body using chakra. The user then spits the water from their mouth as orb-shaped projectiles, whose destructive potential are determined by how much chakra is placed in them. The orbs travel quickly towards the target, dealing extensive damage upon impact. When Gamabunta uses this technique, the water orbs are not only especially large, but are made more lethal because they're shot while he's airborne, thereby adding the force of gravity to their power.

The Kurosuki Family members pile up one on top of the other, five in one pillar, and then send out their gloves' retractable blades and hold out their arms. They then proceed to spin, creating a black tornado-looking attack. The speed makes the attack so powerful that the blades can easily cut through stone.

Haku can quickly freeze the surrounding air and create an icy, transparent igloo-like dome around himself and/or allies to act as a defence. It is strong enough to withstand the air assault of many explosive tags at once, remaining almost undamaged.

When Haido is transformed into a monstrous humanoid, through the powers of the Gelel Stone, he is able to fire a giant bluish-green laser from the back of his right hand, where the stone is embedded. The blast is very powerful and can kill most people in one shot. The laser can be further augmented to fire a much larger blast.

Xianniang is the secondary antagonist in the 2020 live-action remake of Mulan. She is a powerful witch who can shapeshift into a falcon. She can also possess people and shapeshift into those she possesses. She fights alongside Böri Khan in his goal to invade China. Like Mulan, Xianniang has a very strong chi, however, hers is unbalanced giving her great powers. Impersonating the Emperor's chancellor, she convinces China to gather troops to fight the northern invaders and lead them into traps. One such battle she took part in was in a valley against Commander Tung's unit. Marahute is a giant mother eagle who appears in Disney's 1990 animated film The Rescuers Down Under.

Dormammu is an immortal being in Marvel Comics who appears as the secondary antagonist in the 2016 Marvel Studios film Doctor Strange. He exists in a realm called the Dark Dimension. Dormammu was created by Stan Lee and Steve Ditko.

The Eternal is a god of monotheistic religion practiced in the land of Kush on Aerona. He is regarded as an omnipotent and immortal creator, protector, and destroyer. It is said that on the day of Ragalka, the Eternal will return and destroy the world, keeping those mortals he finds worthy. The Muronian Order devotes itself to reminding the public about the fragility of everything.

Drakuseth is a particularly huge Shivan dragon with an explosive fire breath. It is responsible for the death of Marsden, an experienced party leader in Shiv, whose party failed to spread out enough when facing the dragon.

Rimefang was an adult white dragon who half of Vox Machina, as well as Lyra and Zahra Hydris, were contracted to hunt in . As an NPC, he was played by Matthew Mercer.

Unit XDA-1002: Immortalis is a supermassive "new model" of the production line of the magitek infantry developed by Verstael Besithia as its ultimate creation. It is the final boss of Final Fantasy XV: Episode Prompto. It is a giant mechanical wormlike magitek armor with several drill-like appendages on its "mouth". It speedily moves through the snowy terrain and shoots red beams of energy from its magitek core.

Umaril the Unfeathered is one of the last Ayleid sorcerer-kings to have survived the war with St. Alessia. He is the main antagonist of the expansion, and is noted as the chief enemy of Pelinal Whitestrake. Called "the unfeathered" because of his wings, he was an immortal sorcerer, favored of Daedric Prince Meridia, and the son of an Et'Ada, who is noted as being a god of a previous kalpa.

Beela-Kaar, also known as The Mad Sorcerer, was an Argonian sorcerer and trusted adviser for the Saxhleel leaders in ancient Murkmire. He is best known for turning himself into a cursed golden skull in a dark ritual, which became known as the Golden Skull of Beela-Kaar, a relic with the power to destroy all of Murkmire.

Meris, also known as Saint Meris the Peacemaker, is a saint of the Tribunal Temple and the Patron of Farmers and Laborers. As a little girl, Saint Meris showed healing gifts, and trained as a healer. She ended a long and bloody House war, intervening on the battlefield in her white robe to heal warriors and spellcrafters without regard to faction. The troops of all the Houses adopted white robes as their standards, and refused to shed the blood of their brethren. The Swords of St. Meris are five legendary artifacts that will bring despair to the undead. If they are used in war against the Redoran or Indoril, it would be considered a sacrilege. Atarka (/ətɑːrkə/ uh-TARK-uh) is one of the five elder dragons of Tarkir. She is a robust beast with antlers, horns, and fur. She breathes green flames. The ultimate predator, Atarka spends her days, and most of her nights, hunting and feasting.

Akunda, the thunder lizard, is the loa of storms and new beginnings. He believes that the storm has the power to wash away regret and sorrow. Through a sacred ritual, Akunda enters the minds of those who come to his temple in Vol'dun seeking refuge and removes the memories that cause them pain. His followers do good works to show the loa they are worthy of his blessing. The unwanted painful memories that Akunda takes from his followers are stored in the Valley of Sorrows, where Akunda's power (normally) keeps them sealed away. As he commands the storms, Akunda allows the Eternal Spring near his temple to never run dry.
Chiss-Goria is an ancient and particularly nasty furnace dragon of Mirrodin. After spending much time slumbering he rose to fight the Phyrexians during New Phyrexia's Invasion of the Multiverse.

Skysunder, Herald of the Rimelord was a white dragon and scout in service to Errevon the Rimelord who had been sealed within the Frostfell, the Elemental Plane of Ice. She was one of Vorugal's children. As an NPC, Skysunder was played by Matthew Mercer.

In his initial jinchūriki form, Naruto first rushes forward with a shoulder charge. Once he connects, he then unleashes a brutal series of claw slashes until he rise-slashes ending with a downward slash, then in an instant releases all built-up chakra in a powerful Nine-Tails Burst which blasts away the victim.

Morgana's Ice Cave was a cave in the Arctic, home to Morgana, Ursula's younger sister. Melody, Ariel and Eric's daughter, is led to Morgana by her henchmen Undertow and Cloak and Dagger so she can ask her for her help, having been told by Undertow that Morgana has great magic powers. It is here that Morgana temporarily transforms Melody into a mermaid as part of her plan to manipulate the young girl to steal the trident that belonged to her grandfather, Triton. After successfully tricking Melody into giving her the trident, Morgana rises out of her ice cave and declares herself queen of the seas. It is a unique form of Ravemon that has temporarily reached the limits of its abilities through Burst Digivolution, and wears all the energy within the atmosphere as an aura. Attacks *: Enlarges its wings to a gigantic size and releases a dark purple aura. *: Furiously performs a terrible and wild dance of violence. *: Stabs the opponent in a flash of thunder with its dark purple aura.

PileVolcamon is a Cyborg Digimon. It is one of the digivolutions of Volcamon, of which there are said to be seven types. It possesses tremendous power and destructive force, and is well-versed in all sorts of combat techniques, starting with those from . As it digivolved, its original massive body was polished even more, transforming it into a smart form suited for hand-to-hand combat. Any fight with GreatGrizzlymon, its eternal rival, is a big event that draws in large crowds. Bai Mianxi, the White-Faced One, is revered as the first Kitsune and the original nine-tailed fox. Bai Mianxi was born a typical fox in the days following the War of Shame, but gradually awoke to be more intelligent and aware than others of her kind, and then learned to change shapes. She gathered a group of similarly clever foxes together, but she was clearly the leader. One day she chased a rabbit down a well, and found herself instead in Heaven. The Authority, or Mr. A, is an Insatiable crime lord with a number of Lost and Forsaken in his organization. He initially struck out as a vigilante after coming into his powers, but quickly realized that he could control others through fear--including gruesome displays of fiery strength against anyone who challenged him. He took over a werewolf drug ring and quickly grew it into a criminal empire. Mr. A is surrounded at all times by at least four bodyguards. He appears to be a handsome red-headed man who always dresses in sharp suits; if he reveals his Horrible Form, he resembles a humanoid mass of molten lava. She is the killing strike of the bird of prey and the mauling ferocity of the predatory big cat. The spirit shrieks and stabs with its eagle's beak, as well as killing with the powerful, raking claws of a lioness. Her strength and speed is born of both these beings, as well as her unending desire to hunt, to kill, to survive. Everything in her soul hates humanity's false domination over the natural world. CQC Specialists are miniature Cybertronians, who always remain cloaked (unless shot). They remain stunned after being revealed, and so are then easy to kill. they are armed with Plasma cannons. As they charge up the cannons, you can see they light and therefore know where the Cloaker is.

:Jet Snipers and Jet Lasers are Decepticlones from the video game portion of the Unicron Trilogy continuity family. Jet Lasers make up the bulk of the Decepticlone army's aerial force. They tend to patrol in squads of three, circling wide areas in search of Autobots, though occasionally there will be lone scouts or packs as large as six. Once they find their targets, they stop and hover in midair to release blasts of laser fire, plus the occasional railgun shot. Jet Lasers attack by circling a target and attacking from all sides, then dodging when their victim attempts to retaliate. They are highly susceptible to flak cannon fire, which knocks them out of the air into an uncontrolled crash.

A werewolf is a ferocious wild beast-like monster. Normally it is in human form, however, on moonlit nights, it transforms into a humanoid wolf-like creature. The relationship between the werewolf and the moon has been known since the 16th Century, with its power increasing based on the strength of the moonlight. A beast of western origin. In exchange for its lack of a unique ability, its physical power towers above the rest. Especially in terms of agility, it is said that there is no equal. It possesses a deep connection to the moon, where its strength increases proportional to the intensity of moonlight.

The Crusher, also known as the Charger, was a heavily-armored Stage 6 caste that evolved from the Sentry. Its most notable features are its large head crest, which is said to be completely bulletproof, and its habit of charging its prey to inflict massive blunt force trauma. It acts as something of a heavy unit for the Xenomorphs, able to engage even armored vehicles with some success. This is considered to be the Xenomorph equivalent of a tank.

Kaidou of the Beasts, renowned as the world's "Strongest Creature", is the Governor-General of the Beasts Pirates and was formerly one of the Four Emperors who ruled over the New World. He is also the father of Yamato. Once a child soldier in the service of the Vodka Kingdom, Kaidou escaped being drafted by the Marines and joined the legendary Rocks Pirates as an apprentice in his teenage years. A few years after the God Valley Incident, he formed his own pirate crew and built it up into a powerful military force determined to challenge the World Government and change the world. By encasing their arm in rock, the user can deal a powerful hardened punch against an opponent while being protected from direct contact with their target. If necessary, the weight of the rock can be increased to further increase the punch's destructive power.

Momoshiki directs pieces of rubble at a target. By tensing his fingers, Momoshiki can heat the rubble remotely, causing it to cling to targets when it contacts them and inflict severe burns. By clenching his fist, he can make the rubble detonate, creating enough force to break through Susanoo.

Itachi slashes the opponent with his sword coated in flames, following with putting them under a genjutsu where they are hit with flame twisters.

Guren releases two tenketsu points to greatly increase her chakra and physical capabilities for a short time by changing her life force into chakra. This allows the use of taxing techniques such as Crystal Release: String of Glory. The amount of chakra released is so much that it becomes visible and causes water to form a vortex around her, similar to the one caused by opening the "Sixth Gate of Joy" from the Eight Gates. Her eyes also turn completely white momentarily.

Rock Lee unlocks five of the Eight Gates and begins a kick so fast that his leg catches fire. Lee spins around into the air, creating a spiral of flame before bringing his leg down through the centre and into the ground. The fire bursts outwards, blasting any enemy within close proximity.

Kidōmaru secretes Spider Sticky Gold from his pores like sweat until it fully covers his body. It solidifies instantly when it makes contact with the air, becoming a defensive armour as strong as steel. Kidōmaru can produce the armour very quickly, even against attacks that take him by surprise. As a special property of the Sticky Gold, the armour is fortified against chakra, granting Kidōmaru resistance to many ninjutsu and insulating him from attacks such as the Gentle Fist.

This technique is a specialty of the Inuzuka clan. The Inuzuka and their ninken companion perform the Combination Transformation to take the shared form of a two-headed wolf. Because of the transformation's size, its strong claws, and its two sets of fangs, its standard attacks are quite powerful. This is especially true of any other jutsu performed while using this form, which are far more destructive than what the Inuzuka or the ninken are ordinarily capable of. These attacks and jutsu are most often performed against targets that have been cornered, fitting their wolf form.

Kotetsu summons his Conch Shell Mace and begins to spin wildly, beating the opponent, and at the end makes a powerful swing with the mace from the bottom up and sends the opponent flying with a powerful blow.

With this technique, a countless number of summoned snakes crawl out of Orochimaru's mouth and hunt down the enemy. With such overwhelming numbers, a true "wall of snakes" is formed, making defence and evasion meaningless. The enemy can do nothing but become buried by the snakes. The snakes can bite the enemy with their poison fangs and open their mouths to extend Kusanagi-like blades, making them even more deadly. Furthermore, when the inexhaustibly crawling snakes gather together, they become a defensive wall, and can block any kind of attack.

Golf Daiō is Bowser's second alter-ego in the Super Mario Land manga miniseries of the KC Deluxe series, during the events of the first two chapters of the third issue. This time around, Bowser wears a mechanical golf ball costume, with an ever-changing headgear shaped like the clubhead he intends to use. He also has various mechanical tentacles with a different clubhead. He has two ways to swing the ball: using the tentacles or charging and rolling in a ball and hitting the golf ball with his headgear. X-23 (real name Laura Kinney) is a superhero from Marvel Comics. A mutant with a healing factor and imbued with unbreakable Adamantium claws, she is the daughter of Wolverine. X-23 was created by Marty Isenberg, Robert N. Skir, and David Wise.
The Fiery Dragon is a creature made of Hell Fire that appears at the end of the Haunted Mansion film. It is a large dragon-like being made of fire that emerges from the fireplace.

Technor is a recurring villain from Teamo Supremo. He is a robot in the likeness of a computer monitor, built by Mr. Paulson to be a computerized therapist for a universal health-care plan. However, when the plan was cancelled, Technor went rogue and turned into a power-hungry tyrant. Technor controls his large mech, the Magnabody, which he uses to drain power from any source. However, when detached from the Magnabody, his main method of transportation is the flying therapist's couch on which he sits. Technor's weakness is that he can be powered down if he grabs cables for a power source that is then shut off, or if the "off" switch in his Magnabody is pulled.
Omnislash is a recurring technique associated with Cloud. It allows the user to fly around, repeatedly slashing opponents.

A Tyrosaur, or "Tyro" for short, is a winged dinosaur-like creature native to Beast Island. She-Ra once encountered a wounded Tyrosaur near the Fright Zone and managed to calm it enough so she could heal its wing.
